title: Lead UX Designer
description:
**About this role**
-------------------

  

We’re looking for a **Lead UX Designer who is AI\-forward and excited about growing business\-critical product lines while achieving a high bar for ease of use for our customers.** This is a unique opportunity for a customer\-obsessed UX and Customer Experience designer to help shape product innovation through research, design, experimentation, and rapid prototyping.


In this role, you will help design UX and product innovations while applying lean product principles in everything you do. You will use modern AI tools to accelerate ideation, explore design concepts, create prototypes, and validate product experiences while maintaining strong human\-centered design principles, quality, accessibility, and usability standards.


This position involves leveraging insights from user research, interviews, and surveys and translating them into data\-grounded design solutions, including sitemaps, user flows, customer journey maps, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes. You will conduct usability research and testing to evaluate and shape your interactions, workflows, and overall product experience. You will also be expected to design the overall functionality of the product and iterate based on research findings, user feedback, and validated learning.


Having a strong goal orientation, rather than a task orientation, and anchoring decisions in the client experience will help you navigate the challenges involved in building great products.  



  

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Translate concepts into user flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes that lead to intuitive user experiences.
* Leverage insights from user research, interviews, and surveys to develop data\-grounded UX solutions.
* Conduct usability research and testing to shape interaction design, validate workflows, and improve the overall user experience.
* Translate research findings into user flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and other design artifacts that address user needs and business goals.
* Apply an AI\-forward design approach by using AI tools to rapidly explore concepts, generate design variations, test ideas, and develop high\-fidelity prototypes.
* Create AI\-assisted prototypes that communicate product vision, demonstrate workflows, and enable early validation with users, stakeholders, and development teams.
* Design and deliver wireframes, user stories, user journeys, reusable UX components, front\-end libraries, and mockups optimized for a wide range of devices and interfaces.
* Identify design problems and devise elegant solutions based on a user\-centered design approach; rapidly test and iterate designs based on business requirements and customer feedback.
* Create graphics and web layouts that highlight important insights, clarify complex data, and create a narrative flow to maximize user impact.
* Implement a lean approach to product development in which you and the team strive for early validated learning that leads to shorter cycle times and faster delivery of customer value.
* Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, content designers, and other stakeholders to define and deliver cohesive product experiences.
* Evaluate and incorporate emerging AI capabilities into the design process and product experience, ensuring that AI\-enabled solutions are useful, understandable, inclusive, and aligned with user needs.
* Support multiple long\- and short\-term projects while actively prioritizing workflow based on ROI and business value generated.
Contribute to and evolve design systems, patterns, and best practices across products and experiences.  
* 

  

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* Degree in a related discipline with 7\+ years of experience in product or UI design solutions based in fully digital environments.
* An AI\-forward mindset and demonstrated experience using AI tools for UX ideation, design exploration, workflow development, and rapid prototyping.
* Proficiency in using AI\-powered design and prototyping tools to create, iterate, and communicate product concepts efficiently.
* A strong understanding of basic front end development and feasibilities.
* A solid grasp of user\-centered design, human\-computer interaction, planning and conducting user research, usability research, user testing, A/B testing, rapid prototyping, heuristic analysis, usability, and accessibility.
* Ability to work with geographically distributed teams to understand detailed requirements and design user experiences that meet client needs and business objectives.
* Strong visual design, brand, and user experience instincts, with the ability to iterate designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.
* Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.
* Ability to balance AI\-assisted design workflows with sound UX judgment, critical thinking, ethical considerations, and human\-centered decision\-making.
* Experience designing or prototyping AI\-enabled experiences, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, or data\-informed product experiences is a plus.
Be passionate about resolving user pain points through great design, innovation, and emerging technology.  
* 

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:


* Competitive base salary
* Flexible work environment
* A great work culture

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
We are looking for a **creative, detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer** with experience in both **traditional digital products (web \& mobile)** and **immersive AR/VR experiences**. The ideal candidate has a strong user\-centered mindset, a passion for innovation, and the ability to translate complex ideas into intuitive, visually compelling interfaces. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to design seamless, engaging user experiences across platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and deliver **wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups** for web, mobile, and AR/VR applications.
* Create **immersive and interactive UI/UX experiences** for **Augmented Reality (AR)** and **Virtual Reality (VR)** platforms.
* Conduct **user research, usability testing, and feedback analysis** to identify user needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with **developers, product managers, and stakeholders** to ensure smooth implementation of designs across digital and AR/VR environments.
* Design and maintain **design systems, UI components, and style guides** to ensure visual and interaction consistency.
* Optimize designs for **usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance** across devices and platforms.
* Create UI elements such as **icons, visual assets, and interaction patterns** that enhance the overall user experience.
* Stay updated on **UI/UX, AR/VR design trends, tools, and emerging technologies** to drive innovation and improve product quality.
* Ensure all designs align with **brand guidelines and business goals**.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Design, HCI, Computer Science**, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **3\+ years of experience** in UI/UX design, with **1–2 years of experience working on AR/VR projects**.
* Proficiency in **Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator**, or similar design tools.
* Experience with **AR/VR platforms and tools** such as **Unity, Unreal Engine, ARKit, ARCore, Oculus SDK**, or similar.
* Strong understanding of **user\-centered design, interaction design, usability principles, and information architecture**.
* Ability to create **wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity visual designs**.
* Excellent **communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills**.
* A strong **portfolio showcasing UI/UX and AR/VR projects**, including case studies and design thinking.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
